description_en: Creates a DataAgent and binds a RAM role for accessing resources in your account and the associated context models
description_zh: 创建一个新的 DataAgent，并为它绑定用于访问您账号下资源的 RAM 角色以及需要关联的上下文模型
kebab_example: aliyun sls create-data-agent --context-models order-context --name order-analysis-agent --role-arn 'acs:ram::123456789012****:role/sls-dataagent-role' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataAgent

parameters.help_en: The list of names of the context models associated with the DataAgent. Context models provide business semantics, such as data sources, metrics, dimensions, and terms, for the DataAgent. After the association, the DataAgent can locate your log data when answering questions
parameters.help_zh: 为该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表。上下文模型为 DataAgent 提供业务语义（数据源、指标、维度与术语），关联后 DataAgent 回答问题时才能定位到您的日志数据
parameters.name: context_models

parameters.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表
parameters.help_en: The description of the DataAgent. It is used to describe its scope of responsibilities and applicable scenarios. It is only for display and retrieval purposes and does not affect runtime behavior. The keyword parameter in the list operation performs fuzzy matching with this description
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的描述，用于说明它的职责范围与适用场景，仅供展示与检索，不影响运行行为。列表接口的 keyword 会与该描述做模糊匹配
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The display name. It is a short title for UI display and can contain Chinese characters, spaces, and punctuation marks. The maximum length is 256 characters, calculated by character count rather than byte count. If this parameter is not passed or an empty string is passed, it indicates that the display name is not set. In this case, the operation returns an empty string `""` and does not fall back to `name`. For display purposes, you can use `displayName || name` as a fallback
parameters.help_zh: 显示名，供界面展示的短标题，可使用中文、空格与标点，长度上限 256 个字符（按字符数计算，非字节数）。不传或传空串表示未设置，此时接口回显空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时可按 `displayName || name` 回退
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It must be unique within the same account. It can contain only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length must be 4 to 128 characters. The name cannot be modified after creation. Subsequent queries, updates, and deletions of the DataAgent and its sessions use this name to locate the resource
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，在同一账号内必须唯一。仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与中划线（-），长度 4~128 个字符。创建后不可修改，后续查询、更新、删除 DataAgent 及其会话均以此名称定位资源
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent to access resources in your account. The format is acs:ram::<Alibaba Cloud account ID>:role/<Role name>. The role must allow Simple Log Service to assume it so that the DataAgent can read your data with the permissions of the role. If you call this operation as a RAM user or by assuming a role, the caller must also have the ram:PassRole permission on the role. Otherwise, a 401 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 扮演并用于访问您账号下资源的 RAM 角色 ARN，形如 acs:ram::<阿里云账号UID>:role/<角色名称>。该角色需要允许日志服务扮演，DataAgent 才能以它的权限读取您的数据。使用 RAM 用户或扮演角色调用时，调用者还必须拥有该角色的 ram:PassRole 权限，否则返回 401
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测
parameters.help_en: The system prompt of the DataAgent. It is used to set its role positioning, capability boundaries, and response style
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的系统提示词，用于设定它的角色定位、能力边界与回答风格
parameters.name: system_prompt

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the configurations of the created DataAgent. The fields are the same as those in the request body
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回创建完成的 DataAgent 配置，字段与请求体一致

contextModels.description_en: The list of names of the context models associated with the DataAgent
contextModels.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表

items.description_en: The name of a single context model
items.description_zh: 单个上下文模型的名称

createdAt.description_en: The creation time. The time is in the ISO 8601 format in the UTC time zone and accurate to seconds
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC 时区的 ISO8601 格式，精确到秒

description.description_en: The description of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if it is not set
description.description_zh: DataAgent 的描述。未设置时返回空串
description.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表

displayName.description_en: The display name. An empty string `""` is returned if it is not set, and it does not fall back to `name`. For display purposes, use `displayName || name` as a fallback
displayName.description_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent
roleArn.description_zh: DataAgent 扮演的 RAM 角色 ARN

systemPrompt.description_en: The system prompt of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if it is not set
systemPrompt.description_zh: DataAgent 的系统提示词。未设置时返回空串
systemPrompt.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last update. The format is the same as that of createdAt
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次更新的时间，格式同 createdAt

userId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the DataAgent belongs
userId.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 归属的阿里云账号 ID

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. The configurations required to create a DataAgent
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。创建 DataAgent 所需的配置
v1_body_parameters.name: body
